title: Frontend Product Map Preview Confidence Probe v1
stopConditions: The probe edits product repository behavior or Project Control truth beyond a bounded PLAN return.
The returned handoff lacks terminal status, automatic Return Channel evidence, retrievable locator, or explicit risks and unknowns.
The probe promotes Preview readiness, frontend readiness, Publish readiness, WYSIWYG readiness, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
The next lane would require Backend, Core, Editor, renderer, storage, API key, or PDF behavior without a new approved lane and evidence target.
verificationTarget: Project Control records the read-only lane-preview-confidence-probe result as a bounded evidence-review handoff that defines Preview vocabulary, evidence gaps, and lane-preview-confidence-validation without promoting Preview readiness.
summary: Done: PLAN accepted the Preview Confidence Probe as a no-edit planning/evidence-review result. It recommends lane-preview-confidence-validation with parallelLimit 1 before any Preview readiness claim.
